split_policy: Source-family, duplicate-group, and temporal holdout labels are explicit per query. Duplicate publications sharing duplicate_group must stay in one split.
index_exclusion: judgments.jsonl and answer keys are evaluation-only and must never be indexed.
notes: Development set contains domain-specific machine-generated cases grounded in repository fixture semantics plus explicit cross-domain and synthetic adversarial slices. Judgments remain unreviewed and are not gold.
